decisions.decision: Board consensus not to offer health insurance benefits to elected officials, following the Finance Committee chair's emailed view; no vote recorded.
decisions.quote: paula believes the consensus stands not to offer health insurance benefits to elected officials.

decisions.decision: Board consensus to conduct a feasibility study on municipal electric aggregation; an RFP for a consultant was viewed as premature.

decisions.decision: Board asked that a letter be sent to Ways and Means supporting the Municipal Utility Bill and asking that it be expedited out of committee; Paula to work with Kerry on the draft.
decisions.quote: board would like a letter sent to the ways and means expressing our support and that this be expedited out of committee before the end of the month.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three warrants were reviewed and signed, with totals printed for each.
The state no longer funds the 12.5% reimbursement for the December 08 Ice Storm, leaving a $150,000.00 shortfall; the manager expects local receipts overage to cover it without using stabilization.
budget_items.quote: leaves us with the need to make up $150,000.00.

budget_items.topic: Health insurance for elected officials cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The chair cited a potential FY'11 deficit of $150,000 as reason the benefit cannot be reinstated now.
budget_items.quote: the potential deficit of $150,000 for fy'11 cannot at this time justify reinstating the benefit

budget_items.topic: Cuts to elected officials' stipends over time
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A member recounted that the amount for board members was cut from $1500 to $100 a year over the years.
budget_items.quote: started with $1500 and now reduced to $100 a year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Colonial Power said savings could be a few dollars a month for ratepayers and generation is about half of the bill; no town cost noted.
budget_items.quote: savings vary depending upon the use, could be a few dollars a month back in everyone's pocket

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The consultant's fee would be paid through the rate structure as a percentage, with their costs figured into the rate.
budget_items.quote: the way the fee is structured is through the rate structure and they receive a percentage, their costs are figured into the rate.
